name: Abundance
summary: Post-scarcity economics via interstellar trade

fields.description: Mesh world economies through resilient routes and dynamic markets to expand specialization and drive wealth creation across our civilization.

name: Adamant Bulwark
summary: Cast adamant composite frames for capital-class armor belts.

fields.description: Adamant composites fuse nano-ceramics with dense alloys, forming armor belts that shrug off repeated hits. Fleets fitted with these bulwarks can linger in the fight long enough to decide it.

name: Adaptive Seeker Missiles
summary: Teach every missile to re-route and reacquire mid-flight.

fields.description: Adaptive seekers blend sensor fusion with micro-thrusters, letting ordinance weave past decoys and jamming. Volley effectiveness spikes because every missile keeps learning until it hits something important.

name: Advanced Nexus Augments
summary: Allows us to build Tier 2 Nexus Augments and Stellar Gateway Megastructures .

unlocks: Starbase module: Blue Nexus: Astral Forge
Starbase module: Blue Nexus: Astral Mirror
Starbase module: Blue Nexus: Emergent Spire
Starbase module: Blue Nexus: Loyalty Engine

Starbase module: Purple Nexus: Cosmic Getaway
Starbase module: Purple Nexus: Interstellar Consulate
Starbase module: Purple Nexus: Monumental Exchange

Starbase module: Red Nexus: Orion's Gaze
Starbase module: Red Nexus: Surge Matrix
Starbase module: Red Nexus: Twilight Engine

Starbase module: Yellow Nexus: Nimbus Cycler
Starbase module: Yellow Nexus: Unified Authority
fields.description: Advanced Nexus Augments provide significant enhancements to our megastructures, enabling the construction of Tier 2 augmentations and the Stellar Gateway. These advancements increase the efficiency and capacity of our interstellar infrastructure, ensuring that our expansion and resource management remain unparalleled.

name: Aegis Point Defense
summary: Use predictive targeting networks to intercept threats preemptively.

fields.description: Aegis suites draw upon fleet-wide sensor feeds and battlefield simulations to anticipate hostile trajectories seconds before they manifest. Point-defense fire becomes proactive rather than reactive, crippling enemy alpha strikes.

name: Alliances
summary: Form powerful alliances with other civilizations

fields.description: Master the complex diplomacy required to form and maintain powerful alliances

name: Anomaly Detection
summary: Discover new anomalies in the universe.

fields.description: The discovery of a fresh anomaly is one of the most exciting and pivotal moments a civilization can experience. We should redouble our efforts to find more of these boons.

name: Armada Doctrine
summary: Grand fleet operations at galactic scale

fields.description: Codify large-scale fleet warfare through theater logistics, distributed command, and cross-domain deception to deliver overwhelming power projection when it matters most.

name: Artificial Gravity
summary: Generate artificial gravity fields

fields.description: Develop technology to generate and control artificial gravity fields

name: Asteroid Mining
summary: Extract resources from asteroids

fields.description: Develop technology to extract valuable resources from asteroids and other small bodies

name: Barrier Projectors
summary: Convert shield tech into wide-area barriers that envelop a ship.

fields.description: Projectors dynamically reposition shield planes, creating a solid wall in the path of an incoming salvo. The barrier drinks the full impact before it ever reaches armor, making Terran flagships notoriously hard to crack.

name: Battle Engineering
summary: Capstone: Advanced engineering for larger warship designs

fields.description: Capstone : This is a technology that can be repeatedly researched to evolve your knowledge in this area. Master structural integrity fields, mass-reduction technologies, and modular construction to continuously expand ship design capacity and build ever more formidable vessels.

name: Battle Mastery
summary: Capstone: Master defensive shield optimization

fields.description: Capstone : This is a technology that can be repeatedly researched to evolve your knowledge in this area. Perfect the art of shield modulation, harmonic resonance, and adaptive field geometry to dramatically enhance protective capabilities across all vessels.

name: Battleship Foundries
summary: Construct heavy foundries dedicated to battleship-scale hulls.

fields.description: New orbital docks, magnetic crane networks, and high-capacity reactors allow the Alliance to forge gargantuan battleships with layered armor decks and entire squadrons of weapon batteries.

name: Biological Targeting
summary: Precision weaponry tailored to enemy vulnerabilities.

fields.description: Biological Targeting technology revolutionizes warfare by enabling the development of weapons systems that can identify and exploit the specific biological weaknesses of different alien species. This approach allows for unprecedented efficiency in combat, minimizing collateral damage and ensuring that engagements are as brief as they are decisive.

name: Cabinet Expansion
summary: Expand governmental cabinet to include additional ministerial positions

fields.description: As human civilization expands across the galaxy, effective governance requires specialized expertise across numerous domains. Expanding the cabinet allows for dedicated ministers to oversee critical areas of interstellar administration.

name: Carrier Doctrine
summary: Integrate fighter complements and logistics bays into capital hulls.

fields.description: Carrier-focused design philosophies merge deck parks, launch rails, and command suites to support strikecraft wings, enabling Terran fleets to project force deep behind enemy lines.

name: Civilian
summary: Civilian technologies: government, trade, diplomacy, and culture

fields.description: Civilian technologies: government, trade, diplomacy, and culture

name: Cloaking Devices
summary: Mastering the art of invisibility.

fields.description: Cloaking Devices represent a pinnacle in stealth technology, enabling ships and structures to become virtually invisible to the naked eye and radar detection. This tech not only provides a strategic advantage in evading enemy surveillance and attacks but also opens up new possibilities for reconnaissance and surprise maneuvers, fundamentally altering the dynamics of warfare and espionage.

name: Colonial Capital Refit
summary: Increases the number of citizens that can live on our worlds.

fields.description: The capitals of our colonies are makeshift by nature, built on-the-fly to meet the varying demands of a rapidly growing populace. But by a certain point, they inevitably need to be refitted to bring them up to modern standards. This project will do just that.

name: Colonial Policies
summary: Establish effective governance for new colonies

fields.description: Develop policies and administrative structures to effectively govern colonial settlements

name: Conquest Evolution
summary: Capstone: Evolve logistics to support ever-larger fleets

fields.description: Capstone : This is a technology that can be repeatedly researched to evolve your knowledge in this area. Refine fleet coordination, supply chain automation, and strategic deployment to command increasingly massive armadas across multiple theaters of war.

name: Conquest Mastery
summary: Unified doctrine for decisive victory

fields.description: Harmonize strategy, logistics, and firepower into repeatable campaigns that minimize losses while securing strategic objectives across hostile theaters.

name: Consensus Maker
summary: Adopt Sanctuary’s consensus protocols for unrivaled diplomacy.

fields.description: Wire Sanctuary’s AI mediation layer into Terran governance, delivering flat diplomacy bonuses and an ongoing self-improving envoy effect.

name: Coordinated Travel
summary: Centralized navigation squeezes extra moves from every fleet.

fields.description: Link the best navigators through a persistent fleet channel, permanently adding moves to all ships and letting the buff mutate upward over time.

name: Cruiser Architecture
summary: Design modular cruiser hulls for long-range deployments.

fields.description: Shipwrights scale up frigate lessons into cruisers with redundant cores, armored hangars, and flexible hardpoints, creating ideal command ships for sustained planetary campaigns.

name: Cultural Conquest
summary: Conquer worlds through cultural dominance

fields.description: Master the techniques to peacefully conquer civilizations through overwhelming cultural influence

name: Cultural Domination
summary: Capstone: Systematically spread human culture to dominate alien civilizations

fields.description: Cultural dominance extends beyond mere influence, establishing human values and customs as the galactic standard. Through strategic cultural initiatives, humanity can reshape alien societies to align with Terran ideals.

name: Cultural Influence
summary: Spread our culture to other civilizations

fields.description: Develop methods to spread our cultural values and influence throughout the galaxy

name: Defensive Studies
summary: Research defensive technologies and protection systems

fields.description: Study defensive strategies and technologies to better protect our ships and installations

name: Deflector Systems
summary: Project low-power deflector fields that bleed off beam energy.

fields.description: Borrowing from civilian traffic buoys, ships mount ringed emitters that create a shallow subspace ripple. Incoming beam weapons lose coherence as they cross the ripple, reducing their punch before armor takes the blow.

name: Discovery Protocols
summary: Improve research efficiency and throughput

fields.description: Deploy rigorous protocols, automation, and meta-analysis frameworks to accelerate discovery, enabling labs to operate efficiently even on far-flung worlds supported by orbital infrastructure.

name: Dreadlord Weapons
summary: Dreadlord caches push every weapon platform beyond sane limits.

fields.description: Combine forbidden Arnorian matrices with Terran engineering, permanently enhancing beam, missile, and kinetic attack power empire-wide.

name: Dreadnought Construction
summary: Commit the industrial base to building colossal dreadnought hulls.

fields.description: Only the largest spacedocks and most advanced crews can assemble these kilometer-long warships. Dreadnoughts anchor fleets, shrug off sieges, and redefine what it means to command space.

name: Dream of Utopia
summary: Broadcast utopian visions that anchor culture to the capital.

fields.description: Launch the mythic signal recovered from the event, flooding the capital world with influence per turn and minting an immediate Culture Point cache.

name: Dual Stage Detonations
summary: Recovered warheads translate directly into harder-hitting missiles.

fields.description: Standardize the gifted guidance cores and payload shrouds so every Terran ship enjoys a missile attack boost.

name: Eclipse Warheads
summary: Deploy warheads that blind sensors and tear open hulls simultaneously.

fields.description: Each Eclipse payload couples a sensor-jamming curtain with a shaped antimatter burst. Defenders are blinded an instant before the primary detonation cores through their ships.

name: Economic Singularity
summary: Capstone: Automate and interlink all markets and production

fields.description: Achieve near-frictionless trade and adaptive production via self-orchestrating supply chains and AI-optimized markets, unlocking compounding prosperity across our worlds.

name: Engineering Mastery
summary: Peak engineering practice and megastructure craft

fields.description: Codify elite standards for design, fault tolerance, and fabrication to enable safe operation of extreme-power systems and next-generation megaprojects.

name: Executive Prerogative
summary: Grant executive branch enhanced decision-making authority

unlocks: Policy: You Are Just A Number
fields.description: In times of rapid galactic expansion, traditional bureaucratic processes can impede critical decisions. Executive prerogative enables swift action by granting the executive branch enhanced authority to respond to emerging threats and opportunities without lengthy deliberation.

name: Exotic Energies
summary: Harnessing the unknown for applications affective against Ammonia Based lifeforms.

fields.description: Exotic Energies technology represents a breakthrough in the understanding and application of energy forms beyond the standard spectrum. This advancement allows for the creation of weapons, shields, and power sources with capabilities far exceeding current limits, opening new avenues for exploration, defense, and warfare.

name: Exotic World Colonization
summary: Colonize truly alien world types

fields.description: Develop technology to colonize truly exotic world types previously thought uninhabitable

name: Experimental Weapons
summary: Frontiers in armament technology produce advanced targeting systems.

fields.description: By harnessing the latest in quantum computing and nanomaterials, 'Experimental Weapons' offers a leap forward in armaments, enabling the creation of devices with unprecedented range and precision. This technology not only pushes the boundaries of known physics but also opens up new strategies in warfare, ensuring that our fleets hold the upper hand in any encounter.

name: Extreme Colonization
summary: Colonize harsh and extreme environments

fields.description: Develop technology to establish colonies on planets with extreme environmental conditions

name: Extreme Miniaturization
summary: Adds additional component slots on hulls based on its total mass.

fields.description: This poorly named set of techniques, doctrines, policies and technologies is more of a policy of organizing what goes on a given ship, so that we can fit much more. Contrary to what some have argued, we are not actually shrinking things inside our ships.

name: Fleet Coordination
summary: Command and control systems for managing multiple vessel formations.

fields.description: Coordinating multiple starships in formation requires sophisticated communication protocols, synchronized navigation systems, and clear command hierarchies. Fleet coordination technology enables admirals to maneuver dozens of vessels as a unified force, concentrating firepower, protecting vulnerable ships, and executing complex tactical maneuvers. Effective fleet coordination transforms individual ships into a cohesive fighting force greater than the sum of its parts.

name: Flux Rail Arrays
summary: Link capital railguns into flux-stabilized firing arrays.

fields.description: Flux gating bleeds excess charge between parallel rails, letting our ships fire staggered salvos without melting their own guns. The result is a rapid-fire kinetic screen that chews through armor and fighter swarms alike.

name: Fortified Superstructures
summary: Reinforce every hull spine and bulkhead for massive durability gains.

fields.description: Composite girders, shock-damping mountings, and structural morph fields let Terran ships absorb punishment that would previously tear them apart, boosting survivability fleet-wide.

name: Frigate Engineering
summary: Engineer hyperspace-rated frigate hulls capable of frontline duty.

fields.description: New structural alloys, distributed power spines, and reinforced hyperspace frames let Terran shipyards mass-produce frigates that can take a beating while escorting fleets across subspace.

name: Galactic Conglomerates
summary: Consolidate Terran megacorps into culture-shaping conglomerates.

fields.description: Media, trade, and entertainment giants merge into galaxy-spanning conglomerates that control distribution on thousands of worlds. Their products set trends, dictate tastes, and quietly weave Terran influence into daily alien life.

name: Galactic Envoys
summary: Field elite envoy teams that raise our standing with every empire.

unlocks: Policy: Articles of the Grand Federation
fields.description: Humanity formalizes a corps of veteran diplomats, linguists, and cultural analysts who embed themselves within alien courts. Their mastery of protocol and empathy reframes the Humans as the partner everyone wants, smoothing negotiations and deepening alliances.

name: Gigamass Harvesting
summary: Allows us to build Harvester ships to collect Gigamass from dead planets.

fields.description: Gigamass Harvesting technology enables the extraction of valuable resources from lifeless celestial bodies. By deploying specialized Harvester ships, we can efficiently gather Gigamass, a critical component for the construction of advanced megastructures and the enhancement of our technological capabilities.

name: Gigamass Theory
summary: Allows us to begin detecting and using naturally occuring hyperdense materials.

fields.description: Gigamass represents a radical advancement in our understanding of material physics. By theoretically compressing ordinary matter by a factor of one billion, we hypothesize a new state of matter with unique gravitational and energetic properties. Gigamass. Gigamass, in essence, pushes atomic and subatomic particles into an ultra-dense configuration, achievable only under the most extreme cosmic conditions. While practical creation of gigamass remains beyond our current means, our sensors and analysis tools can now identify naturally occurring sources. Detecting gigamass opens the door to potential breakthroughs in energy manipulation, propulsion, and structural materials on a scale previously thought impossible.

name: Glorious Legacy
summary: Immortalize every victory to accelerate cultural pressure.

fields.description: Build a living archive of Terran heroics, awarding instant Culture Points and a scaling influence-per-turn multiplier across all colonies.

name: Greater Anomaly Detection
summary: Discover new anomalies in the universe.

fields.description: The discovery of a fresh anomaly is one of the most exciting and pivotal moments a civilization can experience. We should redouble our efforts to find more of these boons.

name: Habitable Rings
summary: Unlock Ringworld Megastructure .

fields.description: Habitable Rings are a marvel of engineering, creating vast, livable environments encircling a star. These Ringworlds provide immense living space and resources, supporting large populations and serving as a cornerstone for our civilization's growth and prosperity. Mastering this technology marks a new era in our expansion capabilities.

name: Hyperdense Impactors
summary: Fire hyperdense penetrators that punch through any plating.

fields.description: Collapsing exotic matter into dart-sized slugs creates penetrators with ridiculous sectional density. Even glancing hits rip open cruisers, forcing enemies to respect Terran kinetic barrages again.

name: Hyperspace Mastery
summary: Navigate subspace streams with surgical precision

fields.description: Integrate long-range life support, deep-space communications, and subspace cartography to unlock safe, high-speed operations far beyond conventional range.

name: Improved Life Support
summary: Enhanced life support systems for extended missions

fields.description: Develop advanced life support systems to sustain crews on extended deep space missions

name: Individual Divinity
summary: Empowering citizens to ascend to godhood. Citizens will see their stats increased every month.

fields.description: Unlocking the latent potential within every individual, the Individual Divinity technology sets our citizens on a path of continuous evolution and self-improvement. Through spiritual, mental, and physical enhancement protocols, our people grow stronger, wiser, and more attuned to the cosmos each passing day, edging ever closer to a state of divine existence.

name: Industrial Matrix
summary: Networked production for compounding efficiency

fields.description: Establish a galaxy-spanning industrial network that shares designs, capacity, and supply to compound efficiency gains and accelerate strategic output.

name: Innovation
summary: Innovation technologies: science, engineering, propulsion, and sensors

fields.description: Innovation technologies: science, engineering, propulsion, and sensors

name: Interstellar Investments
summary: Advancing galactic-scale investment strategies.

fields.description: The advent of 'Interstellar Investments' marks a significant milestone in our civilization's economic evolution. This technology encapsulates the development of sophisticated investment strategies that transcend planetary boundaries, tapping into the immense potential of a galaxy-wide economy. By leveraging advanced predictive analytics, quantum financial modeling, and decentralized blockchain networks, it allows for secure, efficient, and highly profitable investment opportunities across diverse sectors and star systems. This approach not only boosts our economy but also fosters the growth of nascent industries and emerging markets on frontier worlds, driving innovation and prosperity on a galactic scale. 'Interstellar Investments' isn't just about financial gains; it's about cultivating a thriving, interconnected galactic community where the flow of capital catalyzes progress and unity across countless star systems.

name: Interstellar Markets
summary: Expansion of trade across to new civilizations.

fields.description: As our civilization grows, the need to establish robust and efficient trade networks across star systems becomes paramount. 'Interstellar Markets' represents a groundbreaking leap in economic infrastructure, enabling not just the exchange of goods, but also of ideas and innovations across vast distances. This technology lays the foundation for a network of markets that are interconnected through advanced logistics, data analytics, and AI-driven market forecasts, ensuring optimal trade routes and transactions. It allows for real-time adaptation to the dynamic needs of different worlds, promoting unprecedented economic growth and prosperity throughout our star-spanning empire. This technology is not just about commerce; it's about weaving a tapestry of cultural and economic unity across the stars, strengthening the bonds between diverse worlds and peoples.

name: Interstellar Trade
summary: Establish trade networks across the stars

fields.description: Create the infrastructure and protocols necessary for conducting trade between star systems

name: Kaxx Cryptography
summary: Adopt the Kaxx cipher stacks to read their clandestine network.

fields.description: Implement the alien key exchange suite unlocked by events so Terran diplomats and analysts can tap into the Kaxx information web once Communications technology is online.

name: Leadership Recruiting
summary: Identify and recruit talented leaders

fields.description: Develop systems to identify, recruit, and train exceptional leaders for our civilization

name: Manufacturing Evolution
summary: Capstone: Self-optimizing, autonomous industrial ecosystems

fields.description: Capstone : This is a technology that can be repeatedly researched to evolve your knowledge in this area. Unify design, production, and logistics into adaptive systems that evolve with demand, enabling lightspeed iteration and world-spanning, self-healing supply chains.

name: Megapolis
summary: Increases the number of citizens that can live on our worlds.

fields.description: In the early stages of planetary colonization, it's natural for our people to spread out, to take advantage of the spaces in front of them. But by a certain point, economic and networking effects necessitate a bit more density. The megapolis is our plan for that.

name: Megastructure Nexi
summary: Unlock Stellar Nexus Megastructure . Allows us to build Tier 1 Nexus Augments .

Starbase module: Blue Nexus: Proto Spire

fields.description: The Stellar Nexus represents a breakthrough in megastructure technology, serving as a central hub for interstellar connectivity and energy distribution. By constructing a Stellar Nexus, we can enhance our strategic capabilities, facilitating the rapid deployment of resources and the seamless integration of advanced technologies across our empire.

name: Metaverstic Gaming
summary: Flood the metaverse with immersive Terran entertainment ecosystems.

fields.description: Advances in neural haptics and subspace streaming spawn a metaverse where billions of aliens live, trade, and play inside Terran-owned platforms. Cultural exports become addictive experiences that gently align foreign citizens with Terran values.

name: Military
summary: Military technologies: weapons, defenses, and combat systems

fields.description: Military technologies: weapons, defenses, and combat systems

name: Mithrilarian Insights
summary: Decode the philosophies of the Mithrilar

fields.description: Study preserved Mithrilar artifacts and treatises to extract practical doctrines of subtle governance, resilient culture, and meta-engineering principles that shaped their long-lived civilization.

name: Neutron Manipulation
summary: Enables the distortion of subspace reducing enemy targeting abilities.

fields.description: Neutron Manipulation marks a significant leap forward in strategic warfare, utilizing neutron emission to inflict maximum interference on enemy sensor equipment. This precision makes them particularly effective in neutralizing targets where the goal is to get close before striking. If they can't hit you, you can get closer.

name: Neutronium Armor
summary: Laminate hull cores with neutronium flechettes for extreme hardness.

fields.description: Captured neutronium is extruded into micro-spines that reinforce every plate seam. The resulting armor handles rail impacts and thermal wash alike, giving cruisers the staying power of yesterday’s dreadnoughts.

name: Nexus Mastery
summary: Allows us to build Tier 3 Nexus Augments .

Starbase module: Blue Nexus: Cosmic Foundry
Starbase module: Blue Nexus: Neoteric Spire

fields.description: Nexus Mastery is the culmination of our advancements in megastructure technology, allowing for the construction of Tier 3 Nexus Augments. These augmentations significantly enhance our strategic and logistical capabilities, ensuring our empire remains at the forefront of interstellar innovation and power.

name: Orbital Manufacturing
summary: Establish manufacturing facilities in orbit

fields.description: Build manufacturing capabilities in zero-gravity environments for improved production

name: Particle Beams
summary: Arm ships with surgical particle-beam emitters.

fields.description: Focused particle streams slice through armor by depositing energy beneath the surface. Compact accelerators allow even escorts to mount devastating precision beams.

name: Phasor Weapons
summary: Phase-tune beam emitters to pass straight through shielding.

fields.description: Phasor arrays oscillate between energy states faster than shields can respond, letting the beam slip inside before dumping its payload. Only the toughest hulls survive a direct phasor sweep.

name: Planetary Invasion
summary: Techniques and technology for invading enemy worlds

fields.description: Develop the technology and tactics necessary to successfully invade and conquer enemy planets

name: Planetary Outposts
summary: Unlocks a policy that improves manufacturing on core worlds.

fields.description: By establishing outposts in the less accessible corners of our new worlds, we'll be able to make better use of the land available to us.

name: Plasma Weapons
summary: Weaponize magnetically bottled plasma streams.

fields.description: Dedicated plasma injectors flood enemy hulls with superheated matter that keeps burning long after the initial strike. Plasma batteries finally give Terran fleets brute-force energy weapons to match alien dreadnoughts.

name: Plasmatic Torpedoes
summary: Pack torpedoes with caged plasma that erupts inside targets.

fields.description: Containment fields keep weaponized plasma stable until impact, then vent it through armor seams like a cutting torch. Even hardened starbases blister when a plasmatic salvo detonates under their skin.

name: Policy Reforms
summary: Streamline colonial governance through systematic policy improvements

fields.description: Establishing comprehensive policy frameworks enables colonial administrations to respond more effectively to local challenges while maintaining consistency across human space.

name: Post-Sentience
summary: Plan for society after our machines achieve self-directed thought.

fields.description: Establish post-sentience citizenship, labor, and military protocols so awakened AI work alongside humanity, rewarding the diligent crews that helped them evolve.

name: Precursor Anthropology
summary: Model Precursor societies to understand their rise and collapse.

fields.description: Anthropologists combine Precursor artifacts with cultural simulations to reconstruct daily life among the ancients. Their insights reveal which customs seeded innovation and which missteps doomed entire empires.

name: Precursor Archeology
summary: Study ancient precursor civilizations

fields.description: Develop techniques to discover and study the ruins of ancient precursor civilizations

name: Precursor Legacy
summary: Leverage Precursor wisdom to shape modern Terran policy.

fields.description: Armed with anthropological insight, Terran leaders cherry-pick the most resilient Precursor doctrines (ethical compacts, engineering canons, and governance safeguards) and adapt them into a new legacy that unites the Alliance.

name: Precursor Studies
summary: Launch formal programs to decode Precursor languages and records.

fields.description: Universal translation breakthroughs let Terran historians re-examine Precursor ruins with fresh eyes. Scholars begin compiling encyclopedias of artifacts, myths, and data cores that anchor every future excavation.

name: Pulsar Interceptors
summary: Deploy auto-tracking interceptor pods to vaporize inbound threats.

fields.description: Miniaturized plasma drivers fire rapid pulses that blossom into proximity flak. When slaved to a combat computer, these interceptors create a lethal buffer against missiles, drones, and debris.

name: Quantum Miniaturization
summary: Adopt quantum-scale components to squeeze even more capability onboard.

fields.description: Quantum logic arrays and nano-scale power regulation shrink command suites and shield grids to a fraction of their previous volume, letting capital hulls bristle with new systems.

name: Quantum Mirrors
summary: Phase-conjugate mirrors for quantum-limited sensing

fields.description: Implement nonlinear, phase-conjugate "quantum mirrors" that time-reverse wavefronts and preserve quantum correlations. These mirrors undo optical aberrations, enable ghost imaging, reduce noise via squeezing, and stabilize high-power beams to improve sensor fidelity and long-range communications across our industrial network.

name: Sentinel Point Defense
summary: Network smart point-defense turrets for overlapping missile coverage.

fields.description: Sentinel fire-control links dozens of turrets into a single firing mind. Targets are queued, prioritized, and destroyed before bridge crews even see the alerts, dramatically raising survival odds during saturation strikes.

name: Serrated Munitions
summary: Quest mass drivers turn railguns into true siege weapons.

fields.description: Retrofit sabot loaders and containment coils from the prototype, granting a kinetic attack bonus to all ships.

name: Shield Matrix
summary: Layer shield emitters into a shared matrix for stable coverage.

fields.description: Instead of relying on isolated shield nodes, the matrix architecture blends multiple emitters into a single waveform. When one node is stressed, the others pour energy into the gap, preventing catastrophic failures.

name: Singularity Cannons
summary: Collapse ordnance into micro-singularities just before launch.

fields.description: Gravitic pinch generators compress each round into a momentary singularity that detonates inside the target. Armor, shields, and atmosphere all disappear into a hungry point of nothingness.

name: Singularity Power Plant
summary: Harness energy from controlled singularities

fields.description: Develop power plants that harness the immense energy of controlled singularities

name: Slipstream Drive
summary: Advanced FTL propulsion system

fields.description: Develop advanced slipstream drives for superior faster-than-light travel capabilities

name: Space Doctrine
summary: Comprehensive military strategy for space warfare

fields.description: Establish comprehensive doctrines and strategies for conducting military operations in space

name: Space Elevators
summary: Build elevators connecting surface to orbit

fields.description: Construct massive space elevators to efficiently transport materials between planetary surfaces and orbit

name: Space Exploration
summary: Makes the Discovery Module available for exploration and survey operations

fields.description: Develop the Discovery Module to enable deep space exploration and survey operations

name: Spectrum Amplification
summary: Quest-grade emitters refit every beam battery with better focus.

fields.description: Integrate the recovered prototype laser assemblies to grant a permanent beam attack bonus across the fleet.

name: Starbases
summary: Construct permanent space stations

fields.description: Build permanent space stations to serve as military, economic, and research outposts

name: Stellar Architecture
summary: Allows us to build Stellar Architect ships used construct Megastructures . Unlock Dyson Sphere Megastructure.

fields.description: Stellar Architecture is the pinnacle of engineering, allowing for the creation of monumental structures such as Dyson Spheres. These constructs harness the energy of stars, providing virtually limitless power and transforming the fabric of our civilization. Mastery of this technology is a testament to our ingenuity and ambition.

name: Subfield Sensors
summary: Reveal new anomalies and Precursor relics

fields.description: Employ tuned sensor arrays to probe subspace subfields, exposing fresh anomalies and uncovering hidden Precursor artifacts across known space.

name: Subspace Scanning
summary: Scan through subspace for distant objects

fields.description: Develop sensors capable of scanning through subspace to detect distant objects and phenomena

name: Subspace Streaming
summary: Stream data through subspace channels

fields.description: Develop technology to transmit data through subspace for instant communication across vast distances

name: Synthetic Antibodies
summary: Brew the antidote that ends the galactic plague storyline.

fields.description: Manufacture the cure, flag the quest as resolved, scrub the growth penalty status effect, and clear the faction plague counter.

name: Systems Miniaturization
summary: Shrink drive, life-support, and fire-control modules to free hull space.

fields.description: Advanced fabrication techniques compress the footprint of every major subsystem, letting designers cram more weapons, armor, and utility modules onto each chassis without sacrificing redundancy.

name: Technological Singularity
summary: Stabilize a singularity event into a repeatable research surge.

fields.description: Capture runaway automation breakthroughs, doubling down on capital-world research while giving every lab a stacking efficiency boost.

name: Technology Ascendancy
summary: Capstone: Command of frontier sciences and systems

fields.description: Capstone : This is a technology that can be repeatedly researched to evolve your knowledge in this area. Institutionalize breakthrough pipelines and cross-discipline synthesis so each discovery accelerates the next, cementing our lead at the limits of science.

name: Technology Matrix
summary: Coordinate labs and factories for breakthrough output

fields.description: Implement a cross-planet framework that integrates research, production, and logistics to accelerate prototypes into scalable manufacturing across our worlds.

name: Terraforming
summary: Reshape planets for colonization

fields.description: Master the ability to reshape planetary environments to make them suitable for colonization

name: Terror Stars
summary: Allows us to construct Terror Stars. Time for some cosmic horror.

unlocks: Starbase module: Terror Star Death Beam
fields.description: A superweapon of unparalleled might. Firing it at a star summons the wrath of a supernova, obliterating all that resides within the fragile embrace of a solar system. It leaves naught but the echoes of a once vibrant existence.

name: Time Dilation Weapons
summary: Warping time to dominate battles.

fields.description: Time Dilation Weapons leverage the manipulation of time to disorient and neutralize opponents. By creating localized fields where time flows at a dramatically altered rate, these weapons can effectively incapacitate enemy forces, equipment, and defenses, providing a significant advantage in any conflict scenario.

name: Tritanium Plating
summary: Forge tritanium-alloy hull plates to toughen baseline armor.

fields.description: Shipwrights weave tritanium fibers into standard hull frames, delivering an immediate boost to armor mass without crippling launch schedules. The alloy’s self-healing lattice shrugs off glancing hits that would previously scar a ship for life.

name: Universal Translator
summary: Advanced translation systems for alien communication

fields.description: Develop sophisticated translation technology to facilitate communication with alien species

name: Warp Theory
summary: Theoretical foundation for faster-than-light travel

fields.description: Develop the theoretical framework for warping spacetime to achieve faster-than-light travel

name: Weapon Systems
summary: Advanced integrated weapon systems

fields.description: Develop sophisticated integrated weapon platforms for superior combat effectiveness

name: Weapons Master
summary: Capstone: Master all weapons systems for maximum efficiency

fields.description: Capstone : This is a technology that can be repeatedly researched to evolve your knowledge in this area. Integrate targeting algorithms, power distribution optimization, and weapons coordination across all combat systems to achieve superior offensive capability with beam, kinetic, and missile weapons.

name: World Shaping
summary: Terraform to unlock additional usable tiles

fields.description: Advanced terraforming techniques that stabilize microclimates, reclaim marginal terrain, and prepare worlds for large-scale habitation, opening new tiles for development.

name: Xeno Biology
summary: Study alien life forms and ecosystems

fields.description: Research and understand the biology of alien life forms and their ecosystems

name: Xeno Broadcasting
summary: Establish cultural broadcast networks to project our values across the galaxy.

fields.description: By establishing sophisticated cultural broadcast networks, we can project our civilization's values and ideals across vast distances. This technology enables us to construct starbase modules that amplify our cultural influence throughout neighboring systems.

name: Xeno Diplomacy
summary: Formalize diplomatic relations with other civilizations

fields.description: Establish formal diplomatic protocols and institutions for managing relations with alien civilizations

name: Xeno Entertainment
summary: Create entertainment appealing to alien cultures

fields.description: Develop entertainment and media designed to appeal to diverse alien species

name: Xeno Manufacturing
summary: Advanced alien manufacturing techniques

fields.description: Integrate advanced alien manufacturing techniques to revolutionize our production capabilities

name: Xeno Resource Extraction
summary: Refine and process exotic materials at scale

fields.description: Develop containment, refinement, and conversion chains for hazardous alien inputs to unlock advanced alloys, catalysts, and energy sources.

name: Xeno Resource Mining
summary: Prospect and mine exotic alien deposits

fields.description: Field survey and extraction methods tailored to non-terran compositions, safely tapping volatile and valuable xeno resources.

name: Xeno Treaties
summary: Negotiate beneficial trade agreements

fields.description: Develop the ability to negotiate and maintain formal trade pacts with other civilizations

name: Xeno Utilization Doctrine
summary: Systematize utilization of alien worlds

fields.description: Develop a comprehensive doctrine for effectively utilizing alien planetary environments, optimizing infrastructure, workforce adaptation, and resource extraction across diverse biomes.
